title: Echo Chamber
prompt:
Create a program that repeats back every line of input it receives, using a while loop, until it receives a blank line.
Sample Input: Hello
World


Sample Output: Hello
World
answer:
Sure, I'd be happy to help you with that! Here's a Python program that meets your requirements. It uses a while loop to repeatedly read lines of input until it encounters a blank line (i.e., an empty string). Then, it prints each line back to the user.

```python
while True:
    line = input("Enter a line (or press Enter to finish): ")

    # Check if the user has entered a blank line (i.e., an empty string)
    if not line:
        break

    print(line)
```

When you run this program and enter "Hello World" as input, it will output:

```
Enter a line (or press Enter to finish): Hello World
Hello World
```

And when you press Enter without entering any text, it will output:

```
Enter a line (or press Enter to finish): 
```
